# Labs64.IO Documentation

Labs64.IO is a modular digital commerce platform with independently deployable services, a shared authenticated edge, tenant-aware policy, OpenAPI contracts, and event-driven audit routing.

## Documentation index

- Overview: /docs/
  - What is Labs64.IO?: /docs/introduction/what-is-labs64-io.html
  - Core Concepts: /docs/introduction/core-concepts.html
  - Architecture Overview: /docs/introduction/architecture.html
- Get Started: /docs/getting-started/
  - Choose a Deployment Path: /docs/getting-started/choose-a-deployment-path/
  - Run One Module Locally: /docs/getting-started/run-one-module-locally/
  - Run the Full Ecosystem Locally: /docs/getting-started/run-the-full-ecosystem-locally/
  - Deploy to Your Kubernetes Cluster: /docs/getting-started/deploy-to-kubernetes/
- Services & Modules: /docs/services/
  - Core Platform: Auth Gateway, AuditFlow, MCP Gateway (planned)
  - Commerce & Billing: NetLicensing (planned), Payment Gateway, Checkout, Invoicing (planned)
  - Extensions: Notifications (planned), Reporting (planned), Customer Portal, GuideChimp (planned)
- Operate & Manage: /docs/operate-manage/
  - Deployment, Helm, gateway routing, persistence, scaling, observability, security, troubleshooting
- Reference: /docs/reference/
  - OpenAPI, events, configuration, images, Helm, glossary
- Community & Contributing: /docs/development/

Planned service pages document an intended design and are not callable API contracts until a release publishes them.
